definitions.explanation: A very polite title used after names, more formal than さん.

examples.japanese: お{客|きゃく}様、こちらへどうぞ。

notes:
USAGE:
- Used in formal/business settings
- Used for customers (お{客|きゃく}{様|さま})
- Used in letters and formal writing
- Used for deities and royalty ({神|かみ}{様|さま}, {王|おう}{様|さま})

HONORIFIC HIERARCHY:
- ～{様|さま} (sama): very formal
- ～さん (san): neutral/polite
- ～{君|くん} (kun): informal (males)
- ～ちゃん (chan): affectionate
